environment.description: Deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB has an AWS WAF WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule with RegexPatternSet matching on SingleQueryArgument 'order' that permits only the pattern ^(ASC|DESC|asc|desc)$ with action BLOCK on non-match, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode. The custom regex rule (priority 2) evaluates the 'order' query parameter and blocks any request where the value does not match the strict pattern. CloudWatch Logs confirm rule evaluation order is respected.

config.waf_rule_2: Custom rule priority 2: FieldToMatch=SingleQueryArgument('order'), RegexPatternSet='^(ASC|DESC|asc|desc)$', Action=BLOCK on NoMatch, TextTransformation=NONE
config.alb: internet-facing ALB with WAF WebACL association
config.note: SizeRestrictions in COUNT mode means large query strings are logged but not blocked
